summary: The proof is correct. It establishes attainment of the diagonal-defect minimum, applies the accepted metronoid nesting theorem with the exact constant, removes at most Delta_diag/delta_* total weight by the weighted Markov argument, and uses the surviving affine selector to exhibit a common point in every barycentric Minkowski sum required by the complete core. The accepted lattice centerpoint and complete-core master bounds then give both asserted inequalities, with the empty and zero-retained-mass cases and the direction of the Delta_ref comparison handled correctly.
